item.title: ‘Sherri’ Daytime Talk Show Canceled After Four Seasons
item.description: Sherri Shepherd’s daytime talk show “Sherri” is coming to an end after four seasons. ​Variety reported that Lionsgate’s producer/distributor shingle Debmar-Mercury confirmed the news on Monday.
